name: scoreboard-lol
description: Esports-style League of Legends broadcast scoreboard overlay for OBS, driven by the Live Client Data API (spectator mode)

scripts.build: esbuild server.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/server.cjs && pkg dist/server.cjs --config package.json --output dist/LoL-Scoreboard.exe && node scripts/set-icon.mjs
scripts.installer: npm run build && npm run panel && node scripts/make-installer.mjs
